Oliver (Design Ops): Hey team, quick design review request 12. I'm experimenting with a more compact roles matrix inside the org settings invite flow. Goal: reduce vertical space and avoid huge scrolling when org has many roles. Screenshot: https://redwood.design/s/compact-roles-matrix.png :camera:

Rina (Design): Compact looks promising. Two UX questions: 1) how do we show the SSO enforcement state per-role (global vs per-invite), and 2) how do we surface keyboard affordances for the new tiny chips?

Ethan (Frontend): For SSO state I prefer a small inline toggle disabled when org-wide enforcement is on, with a tooltip explaining why. Implementation-wise toggles are reliable but tooltips need aria-describedby for a11y.

Marcus (A11y): Quick note: tooltips alone are not accessible. If we show an explanation, it must be reachable by keyboard and screen readers. Use a hidden button that opens a small dialog (role="dialog") with the explanation text, or use aria-live to announce changes. Also chips need 3:1 focus target size; our current 24px buttons are too small.

Priya (PM): Product constraint: we cannot allow per-invite SSO to override org enforcement. So when org enforcement is on, the per-role control should be read-only and clearly labelled. We also want analytics: role_chip_interacted, invite_modal_submitted, sso_hint_opened.

Rina (Design): What about copy? Current helper reads: "SSO enforcement is set at the org level" which feels cluttered. Proposal: "SSO enforced by org" (bold) + 'Learn more' link that opens the dialog Marcus suggested. Short and scannable.

Ethan (Frontend): CSS note: compact grid collapses margins which causes uneven focus outlines when chips wrap. I can add .role-chip:focus { outline-offset: 2px } to keep visible ring. Also will ensure tabindex="0" on chips and role="button" for screen readers.

Marcus (A11y): Good. Also add aria-pressed to chips if they toggle. If you use visually-hidden helper text for screen readers, ensure it's not duplicated in the modal to avoid repetitive reads.

Oliver (Design Ops): Interaction question: when user types an email then selects roles, should the role matrix collapse to show selected only? Feels risky. Maybe add a 'Show selected' filter toggle instead of collapsing automatically.

Priya (PM): Agree on explicit filter. Auto-collapse could hide permissions and confuse people. Add a persisted preference for 'Show selected by default' later as a followup.

Rina (Design): I'll iterate Figma: add a small 'i' helper next to SSO pill that opens inline modal. Will increase chip touch target to 32px and adjust spacing. Posting new frames in a bit.

Ethan (Frontend): Can we keep mobile parity? On narrow view, switch to stacked list with expand/collapse per-role to save space. I'll prototype the CSS grid->stack behavior.

Marcus (A11y): Mobile: ensure expand/collapse uses button semantics and exposes expanded state via aria-expanded. Also ensure focus order remains logical on toggle.

Deploy Bot: preview/compact-roles built  https://staging.redwood/preview/compact-roles (sha: def456) :rocket:

Ethan (Frontend): Ran a quick axe scan on preview, results: 1) contrast on muted helper text (needs darker gray), 2) chips missing accessible names (title attr required), 3) close button inside dialog lacks aria-label.

Rina (Design): I'll darken helper text and add explicit labels in the mock. For naming, propose title="Remove role: Billing" on the x button.

Priya (PM): Small copy decision: CTA should reflect SSO context. Options: 'Invite' / 'Invite (SSO enforced)' / 'Invite & require SSO'. Which is clearest? My vote: show primary 'Invite' and inline microcopy beneath when SSO will be applied: 'SSO will be required for invited users.'

Marcus (A11y): Microcopy under CTA is good, but make sure it's not purely visual; include aria-describedby on the submit button pointing to that text. When submit fails, use aria-live to announce error.

Ethan (Frontend): I'll implement aria-describedby and add unit tests to assert it exists. Also will add keyboard tests for focus landing when dialog opens.

Oliver (Design Ops): Timeline: aim for small A/B with 10% of orgs next sprint. If a11y issues persist, hold. Rina please upload final frames and alt text for each screenshot in the PR.

Rina (Design): Uploaded new frames: https://redwood.design/s/compact-roles-matrix-v2.png alt="Compact roles matrix with SSO info modal open". Updated copy and chip sizes in Figma.

Ethan (Frontend): Opening PR #4820 with changes: improved focus handling, aria labels on chips, increased tap targets, dialog implementation for SSO helper, and contrast fixes. CI will run axe.

Marcus (A11y): I'll review the PR and run NVDA locally. If I hit any blockers I'll comment on the PR directly.

Priya (PM): Thanks all. If PR looks good, we'll target rollout next sprint. Small followup: add telemetry for 'sso_helper_open' to measure confusion.

Oliver (Design Ops): Great work. Closing loop: once PR merges, add to the release notes under 'UI: compact roles matrix (invite flow) + accessibility improvements'. :tada:
